[[Mikrevo]] | capacity = 3,000 | chairman = {{flagicon|BUL}} Valentin Chilikov | manager = {{flagicon|BUL}} Plamen Mitsanski | league = A RFG Blagoevgrad | season = 2021–22 | position = A RFG Blagoevgrad, 6th | pattern_la1=_redshoulders | pattern_b1=_frah06 | pattern_ra1=_redshoulders | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1= | body1= 000020 | leftarm1= 000020 | rightarm1= 000020 | shorts1= 000020 | socks1= 000020 | pattern_la2=_navyborder | pattern_b2= _thinredsides | pattern_ra2=_navyborder | pattern_sh2= | body2= FFFFFF | leftarm2= FFFFFF | rightarm2= FFFFFF | shorts2= FFFFFF | socks2= FF2020 }} '''FC Malesh Mikrevo''' is a [[Bulgaria]]n [[association football]] club based in the village of [[Mikrevo]], [[Blagoevgrad Province]], which currently competes in the [[Regional Amateur Football Groups (Bulgaria)|A RFG Blagoevgrad]], the fourth tier of the Bulgarian football league system. The club was established in 1936. The biggest success in the club's history came in 2010, when the team earned promotion to the [[Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|Bulgarian B PFG]] by decisively winning the South-West V AFG. The club's home ground is the Municipal Stadium in Mikrevo, which has a capacity for 3,000 spectators. In December 2011, [[FC Vihren Sandanski|Vihren Sandanski]] obtained the license of Malesh. Malesh was subsequently demoted to playing in A RFG Blagoevgrad since the 2012–13 season."}}
